verdict.rationale: Square's docs show broad API coverage mirroring many UI functions—payments, refunds, disputes, payouts, invoices, subscriptions, webhooks, sandbox—suggesting strong API/UI parity for core commerce flows. However, there's no explicit claim of full 1:1 parity across all UI features (e.g., team scheduling/payroll, marketing/loyalty engagement UI mentioned in square-docs-3/4 lack matching API docs here), and an older community comment flagged a feature gap (subscriptions) that was seemingly later closed by square-docs-23. missing for 10: explicit parity statement, API coverage evidence for team/payroll and marketing/loyalty UI features, independent confirmation of no gaps.
